user_select_self_or_current_org.name: user_select_self_or_current_org
user_select_self_or_current_org.using:
"user"."id" = app_current_user_id()
    or exists (
      select 1 from member
      where member.user_id = "user"."id" and member.organization_id = app_current_org_id()
    )

checklist_items_select.name: checklist_items_select
checklist_items_select.using: "checklist_items"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and exists (select 1 from tasks where tasks.id = "checklist_items"."task_id")

checklist_items_insert.name: checklist_items_insert

checklist_items_update.name: checklist_items_update

checklist_items_delete.name: checklist_items_delete

task_labels_select.name: task_labels_select
task_labels_select.using: "task_labels"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and exists (select 1 from tasks where tasks.id = "task_labels"."task_id")

task_labels_insert.name: task_labels_insert

task_labels_delete.name: task_labels_delete

tasks_delete.name: tasks_delete
tasks_delete.using:
"tasks"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and app_can_edit_project("tasks"."org_id", "tasks"."project_id")
        and (app_is_org_admin("tasks"."org_id") or "tasks"."created_by" = app_current_user_id())

activity_log_select.name: activity_log_select
activity_log_select.using:
"activity_log"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and (
        app_is_org_admin("activity_log"."org_id")
        or ("activity_log"."project_id" is not null and app_can_view_project("activity_log"."org_id", "activity_log"."project_id"))
      )

activity_log_insert.name: activity_log_insert
activity_log_insert.withCheck:
"activity_log"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and "activity_log"."actor_id" = app_current_user_id()
        and app_is_member_of("activity_log"."org_id")
        and ("activity_log"."project_id" is null or app_can_view_project("activity_log"."org_id", "activity_log"."project_id"))

comment_reactions_select.name: comment_reactions_select
comment_reactions_select.using: "comment_reactions"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and exists (select 1 from comments where comments.id = "comment_reactions"."comment_id")

comment_reactions_insert.name: comment_reactions_insert
comment_reactions_insert.withCheck:
"comment_reactions"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and "comment_reactions"."user_id" = app_current_user_id()
        and exists (select 1 from comments where comments.id = "comment_reactions"."comment_id")

comments_select.name: comments_select
comments_select.using: "comments"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and exists (select 1 from tasks where tasks.id = "comments"."task_id")

comments_insert.name: comments_insert
comments_insert.withCheck:
"comments"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and "comments"."author_id" = app_current_user_id()
        and exists (select 1 from tasks where tasks.id = "comments"."task_id")

comments_delete.name: comments_delete
comments_delete.using:
"comments"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and exists (select 1 from tasks where tasks.id = "comments"."task_id")
        and ("comments"."author_id" = app_current_user_id() or app_is_org_admin("comments"."org_id"))

notifications_select.name: notifications_select
notifications_select.using:
"notifications"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and "notifications"."user_id" = app_current_user_id()
        and exists (select 1 from tasks where tasks.id = "notifications"."task_id")

notifications_insert.name: notifications_insert
notifications_insert.withCheck:
"notifications"."org_id" = app_current_org_id() and "notifications"."actor_id" = app_current_user_id()
        and exists (select 1 from tasks where tasks.id = "notifications"."task_id")
        and exists (
          select 1 from member
          where member.user_id = "notifications"."user_id" and member.organization_id = "notifications"."org_id"
        )
